notes.title: Progress Update #6
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone,[/b]

It's finally time for some new information about [b]Space of one Drama[/b]! 
First, to clear up any doubts - [b]Space of one Drama[/b] is still in development and we have not abandoned it and we do not intend to abandon it. Any delays are unfortunately mainly due to a non-existent budget.

But!

[b]Space of one Drama[/b] steam store page has finally been updated with new screenshots and description. We are still working on a new trailer, so the old one from the early alpha version of the game will have to stay for now.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32779530/6ddb0b32c1cbbc42a22b9a739c56e84cbe283375.png[/img]


There also will be much more information coming soon about [b]Aqua Queen[/b] - a free standalone short game ([i]sort of a introduction/demo[/i]) for a upcoming [b]Space of one Drama[/b].

And in other news. [b]Tomorrow[/b] we will be releasing a big [b]update 1.3[/b] ([i]that we've been slowly working on since last year[/i]) to our previous game [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/593560/The_Last_Cargo/]The Last Cargo[/url][/b]. This update will fix/change and add a lot, so feel free to give it a try when it comes out :)


Thank you all for your support and patience.
- Ehnenu

notes.title: June [2020] Update #5
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone,[/b]


Soon we will take you on an adventure to the [i]"sea stage"[/i] where to complete the performance you have to summon and defeat the terrifying [b]Aqua Queen[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32779530/e9d8f930fdb2ea82e92496987df7abffd2ab2094.png[/img]


The upcoming [b]Space of one Drama: Aqua Queen[/b] will be a free standalone short game [i](sort of a introduction/demo)[/i] for a upcoming [b]Space of One Drama[/b]. 

We still don't know the exact release date, but we doing our best to release polished and fun puzzle/adventure game for you guys.

Thank you for all your support and patience :)

More information coming soon.
[b]- Ehnenu[/b]

notes.title: October (mini) Update #4
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone,[/b]

Unfortunately this month was very exhausting and stressful for us (mostly familly problems) which translated into a lack of focus on our work.

As we only recently were able to back on track, we will try our best to finally show something more next month. We really hate to write pessimistic updates but we prefer to be honest with you all. Sorry guys.

Have a safe and happy Halloween.

notes.title: September (mini) Update #3
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone,[/b]

Time for another very short update.

As we mentioned before, demo will be more of separate short story (sort of a prologue) rather than a classical form of a demo. That's why it taking us more time than we expected and that's why demo release will be unfortunately delayed by some time.

But the good news is, soon we will be able to show something newer than the very old screenshots that are visible in the store.

So see you in the next month space cowboys! Hopefully, with much bigger update.

notes.title: (mini) Progress Update #2
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone,[/b]

We are starting to be satisfied with the results of our work, so in a month or so, new screenshots will finally pop out! And from then, we will be at the last straight for the demo release.

[b]- So in short, what type of game "Space of One Drama" is?[/b]

It's an puzzle adventure game with action elements, that takes place on the stages of a mysterious theater. There is no inventory, no weird item mixing, and no clicking to find the right pixel on the screen. It's all about imaginative puzzles, costumes with unique skills, and even "bosses" to outsmart/defeat at the end of each scene.

Hopefully it will be interesting and relaxing adventure for all of you guys :)
See you in the next month!

notes.title: Upcoming Demo and Progress Update
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone,[/b]

First of all, we want to reassure all of you that the development on the[b] Space of One Drama[/b] are still in progress ([i]slowly but surely[/i]) and we do not plan to give up. Our financial situation doesn't look so good, so it will take us more time to finish working on the game than we anticipated.

[b]BUT![/b]

As some of you already know, we are preparing a special demo of [b]Space of One Drama[/b]. It will be a introduction to the game, so that everyone can get acquainted with the part of mechanics, atmosphere etc. At the same time the demo will be a short but complete story that will not be in the full version of the game ([i]or at last will be added later for player convenience[/i]).

So when's the demo coming? We thought we would finish it by the end of July, but unfortunately the planned release date will be postponed by two to three months ([i]end of September/October[/i]). We are really sorry for the delay, but we think it's gonna be worth the wait :)

And that's it for now. See you in the next progress update, next month!
